name: Tokyo Skytree
desc: 350 m Tembo Deck, optional 450 m Galleria. Pair with Sumida Aquarium downstairs. Book a timed ticket; same-day lines are long on the 11 Jan holiday. Price: Tembo Deck from about ¥1,800 adult / ¥900 child; combo higher.

name: Tokyo Tower
desc: Main Deck at 150 m, Top Deck tour at 250 m. Open late. Easier and cheaper than Skytree if you already walk Shiba / Zojo-ji. Price: Main Deck web ticket ¥1,500; Top Deck Tour about ¥3,300.

name: SHIBUYA SKY
desc: Open rooftop at 229 m above the scramble. Bags often go in lockers. Sunset slots sell out. Price: adult web about ¥2,700 before 15:00, ¥3,400 after; child tickets at the counter.

name: TMG observatories
desc: Free 202 m decks in the city hall twin towers. North and south take turns closing one weekday. Last entry 21:30. Best cheap night view. Price: free.

name: Imperial Palace East Gardens
desc: Edo Castle ruins and lawns, free. Closed Mondays and Fridays, so skip 8 and 11 Jan. Winter hours to 16:00, last entry 15:30. Pair with Marunouchi lights after. Price: free.

name: Yokohama Marine Tower
desc: Harbour tower by Yamashita Park. Landmark Sky Garden is shut until 2028, so this is the waterfront lookout. Easy with Chinatown and the rink. Price: weekdays about ¥1,000 adult / ¥500 child; evenings more.

name: Enoshima Sea Candle
desc: Lighthouse lookout over Shonan. Add it to a Kamakura day via Enoden. Garden ticket includes the tower. Clear days can show Fuji. Price: garden plus tower typically about ¥1,000 adult; child less.
